notes: «صليت إلى جنب ابن عمر» is a scene: Ibn Umar is where Ali prayed, not a transmitter (rule 6); Ali is the last link
«فذكر نحو حديث مالك» names Malik's version as a comparison: a variant group, not a route (rule 4)
«قال سفيان فكان يحيى بن سعيد حدثنا به عن مسلم ثم حدثنيه مسلم» is Sufyan's addition with its own transmitter (Yahya): a variant group (rule 4); the main route's مسلم is the first occurrence
